gallery.selection: FlatLands: first training observation per source plus the second ZInD observation. UnScenes3D: first two scene ids per training location, first timestamp per scene. Sequence: first 18 frozen training frames of the first scene. No outcome-based selection.

examples.selection_rule: target=1, correlated probability exceeds independent probability in all three seeds; rank by mean per-event Brier gain
target=0, independent probability >=0.8 and correlated probability <0.8 in all three seeds; rank by mean per-event Brier gain

brier.title: 路径概率的预测误差：越低越好
brier.note: 横线为三次训练的标准差；单种子与训练集先验不画误差线。

risk.title: 同样愿意接受多少查询，再比较风险
risk.note: 浅色带为训练种子标准差；30% 覆盖率下，两个模型的风险优势并不稳定。

reliability.title: 模型说“有 80% 把握”，能信多少？
reliability.note: 折线越接近灰色对角线，预测概率越符合实际频率；十个概率分箱，按场景加权。

sampling.title: 增加采样次数，结果改变多少？
sampling.note: 固定已训练模型，32 / 64 / 128 使用同一随机流的前缀；误差线为种子标准差。

dependence.title: 每一格的概率不变，路径判断仍会变
dependence.note: 两组保留完全相同的单元格经验概率；只打散跨位置的共同变化。评估干预，未重新训练。

method_labels.marginal_shuffle: 打散空间结构（评估干预）
